create_paddleocr_vision_config: create a PaddleOCRVisionConfig instance with custom vision model parameters like hidden_size, image_size, and patch_size
create_paddleocr_text_config: create a PaddleOCRTextConfig instance with custom text model parameters like vocab_size, hidden_size, and max_position_embeddings
create_paddleocr_vl_config: create a PaddleOCRVLConfig instance combining vision and text sub-configs for the multimodal PaddleOCR-VL model
build_paddleocr_vl_configuration: build a PaddleOCRVLConfig from flat dict kwargs by initializing vision and text sub-configs automatically
review_paddleocr_config_post_init: review the __post_init__ methods of PaddleOCRTextConfig and PaddleOCRVLConfig that handle default parameter resolution
